instrumentation.content:
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shlex
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from time import perf_counter
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

import requests
import paramiko

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect(hostname=os.environ["AGOM_VPS_HOST"],
    port=int(os.environ.get("AGOM_VPS_PORT", "22")),
    username=os.environ.get("AGOM_VPS_USER", "root"),
    password=os.environ["AGOM_VPS_PASS"], timeout=20)
domain_reader = "from pathlib import Path; lines=Path('/opt/agomtradepro/secrets.env').read_text().splitlines(); print(next((line.split('=',1)[1].strip().strip(chr(34)).strip(chr(39)) for line in lines if line.startswith('DOMAIN=')), ''))"
_stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("python3 -c " + shlex.quote(domain_reader), timeout=25)
domain = stdout.read().decode("utf-8").strip()
assert stdout.channel.recv_exit_status() == 0
client.close()
assert re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9.-]+", domain), "Production DOMAIN is unavailable or invalid"
base = urlsplit("https://" + domain)
assert base.scheme in {"http", "https"} and base.hostname and base.username is None
origin = f"{base.scheme}://{base.netloc}"
results = []
for path in ("/api/health/", "/metrics/"):
    started = perf_counter()
    response = requests.get(origin + path, timeout=25, allow_redirects=False)
    completed = datetime.now(UTC)
    entry = {
        "path": path,
        "status_code": response.status_code,
        "content_type": response.headers.get("Content-Type"),
        "elapsed_seconds": perf_counter() - started,
        "response_completed_at": completed.isoformat(),
        "raw_http_response_sha256": hashlib.sha256(response.content).hexdigest(),
    }
    if path == "/metrics/" and response.status_code == 200:
        entry["selected_outbox_metric_lines"] = [line for line in response.text.splitlines() if (
            line.startswith("system_audit_outbox_")
            or line.startswith("# HELP system_audit_outbox_")
            or line.startswith("# TYPE system_audit_outbox_")
        )]
    elif path == "/api/health/" and response.status_code == 200:
        entry["health_response"] = response.json()
    results.append(entry)
record = {
    "operation": "AUD-03 actual unauthenticated HTTP health and metrics read",
    "origin": origin,
    "results": results,
    "limits": [
        "Actual deployed HTTP responses; no process-local Django shell metric export.",
        "Only bounded outbox metric lines are retained; full metrics response is represented by its byte hash.",
        "No dispatch, runtime activation, alert, TUI, recovery or acceptance is inferred.",
    ],
}
Path("var/aud03-http-metrics-20260913.json").write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(record))

interpretation: TLS verification stayed enabled. Actual HTTPS health and metrics endpoints returned 200 with JSON and Prometheus Content-Types respectively.

Seven audit outbox gauges each expose only the bounded owner=audit label. Pending and due_pending equal 2; claimed, expired_claimed, failed and delivered equal 0. Oldest backlog age is 19885.026227 seconds in this HTTP sample.
The raw full HTTP body byte hashes are captured by the collector; only bounded outbox metric lines and the health object are retained in the sealed observation, not the full metrics body.

Counts agree with the prior production read-only snapshot. Different sample times explain the increased age; no zero-loss, duplicate-free recovery, alert, admin TUI or archive/restore acceptance is inferred.
Local response_completed_at uses the local collector clock; the health object's timestamp and metric age originate from the server. They are not treated as an exact synchronized clock pair.

The first HTTP helper attempt used the generic local loopback base URL and was refused before contacting production. The successful collector derives only public DOMAIN from the authorized VPS configuration; no secret values are recorded.
